verdict.rationale: Superset shows real-time status (running agents/open ports inline, finished/waiting-for-input notifications) and a dashboard to monitor many concurrent agent sessions, corroborated by a power user managing 40-50 simultaneous sessions. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account specifically describing live status accuracy/latency, and no detail on how granular the 'current status' feed is beyond finished/waiting states.
